description: Logic and quantifiers, basic set theory, mathematical induction and recursive definitions, divide and conquer recurrence relations, properties of integers, counting, functions and relations, countable and uncountable sets, asymptotic notation.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete 1 of the following
    • Complete 1 of:
      • MATH100 - Calculus I (1.5)
      • MATH102 - Calculus for Students in the Social and Biological Sciences (1.5)
      • MATH109 - Introduction to Calculus (1.5)
      • MATH151 - Finite Mathematics (1.5)
    • Completed Pre-Calculus 12 with a minimum grade of (90%)
    • or permission of the Department.
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of MATH 122, MATH 224, CENG 245.
  • Not open for credit to students with credit in any of MATH 222, MATH 422, MATH 423.
